reason: Global-index support for `index_merge`/`mem_index_merge` is a high-blast-radius change: it alters planner path selection (`find_best_task.go`, `indexmerge_path.go`), executor behavior for index-merge readers (`builder.go`, `index_merge_reader.go`, `mem_reader.go`), and KV key handling (`key.go`). That combination can hide serious correctness issues around plan choice, row retrieval semantics, and global-index key/partition interactions, so it merits a dedicated deep review for Blocker/High bugs.
